title: Cameras software versions MV 8.0 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new Beta MV Cameras firmware is now available
A new Recommended Release MV Cameras firmware is now available

Bug fixes: Improved firmware upgrade reliability and recovery
Improved stability of core video and camera services
General: Improved database reliability, migration handling, and storage efficiency
Improved firmware security and vulnerability protection
Updated core camera, recording, analytics, and system-management components
Notice: When configured for this version, MV21 & MV71 cameras will run MV4.15
MV7.2 is the last supported firmware branch for MV12, MV2, MV22, MV32, MV52 and MV72 series. Future updates for these models will be limited to maintenance and security patches

html:
Cameras software versions MV 8.0 changelog

 

Bug fixes

  • Improved camera connectivity and reliability

  • Improved firmware upgrade reliability and recovery

  • Improved stability of core video and camera services

General

  • Improved database reliability, migration handling, and storage efficiency

  • Improved firmware security and vulnerability protection

  • Updated core camera, recording, analytics, and system-management components

Notice

  • When configured for this version, MV21 & MV71 cameras will run MV4.15

  • MV7.2 is the last supported firmware branch for MV12, MV2, MV22, MV32, MV52 and MV72 series. Future updates for these models will be limited to maintenance and security patches
